     A.   ORDINANCE 108-2024-25 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-25-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Faith Investments, for a zone change on a parcel fronting on the
          western frontage of Alpine Dr, approximately 420 ft south of the W Dunbar Cave Rd
          and Alpine Dr intersection from O-1 Office District to M-1 Light Industrial District.
          RPC: Approval/Approval

     B.   ORDINANCE 109-2024-25 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-26-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Christian Innovative Enterprises, LLC, for a zone change on a parcel
          of land fronting on the northern frontage of Kennedy Rd at the terminus of Stone
          Bluff Wy and Kennedy Rd intersection from AG Agricultural District to R-2A Single
          Family Residential District. RPC: Approval/Approval

          include Fort Campbell Boulevard and Tiny Town Road Corridors. RPC: These
          standards would be best implemented as part of the zoning rewrite or city-
          wide / Approval

7.   Consent Agenda
     All items in this portion of the agenda are considered to be routine and non-controversial
     by the Council and may be approved by one motion; however, a member of the Council
     may request that an item be removed for separate consideration under the appropriate
     committee report:

     A.   ORDINANCE 83-2024-25 (SECOND READING) An Ordinance amending the
          Official Code of the City of Clarksville Title 4 (Building, Utility and Housing Codes),
          Chapter 6 (Property Maintenance Code) to provide needed updates, add provisions
          regarding penalties, and clarify requirements for property maintenance in
          commercial and residential zones.

     B.   ORDINANCE 85-2024-25 (SECOND READING) An Ordinance amending Title 2
          (Alcoholic Beverages), Chapter 1 (Beer) of the Official City Code to amend Section
          2-105 (Classes of Permits), Sub-Paragraph (4) ("Special Events Permit")

     C.   ORDINANCE 86-2024-25 (SECOND READING) [ZONING CASE Z-21-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning ordinance and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Audrey Short Rothstein, for a zone change on a parcel fronting on the
          south frontage of Tiny Town Road, 335 +/- feet east of Pembroke Rd and Tiny
          Town Rd from A-Airport to C-5 Highway and Arterial Commercial District.

     D.   ORDINANCE 89-2024-25 (SECOND READING) [ZONING CASE Z-24-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning ordinance and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Millan Holdings, LLC, for a zone change on a lot fronting on the west
          frontage of Industrial Dr, 390 +/- feet north of the W Dunbar Cave Rd and Industrial
          Dr intersection from M-1 Light Industrial District to C-5 Highway and Arterial
          Commercial District.
